name: Yang Dimension / Characteristic-zero Yang Dimension
details: For every finite binary class, $\mathrm Y=\mathrm Y_2\ge\mathrm Y_0$. The inequality is strict on the Anchored Torsion Class. This is the default characteristic-two specialization, not a comparison involving a variable prime.
proof_source: Survey Corollary prop:yang-characteristic-separation gives the universal inequality and points to the database-owned witness value proofs.
witness_verification: The database-owned exact values on the Anchored Torsion Class are Y=4 and Y_0=3. They refute the reverse exact domination but do not refute any reverse affine bound.
